_comment: spec 130 FR-009..FR-011: fixed-text board messages whose wording makes a next-action or protection claim. Read by verify-board-message-parts.py mode 2. A variant's `when` keys (auto_merge, kill_switch, pr_class) are wildcards when absent; `reachable` limits the configurations a message can be posted in. Claims: board_merges_next_run (false when the kill switch is set or auto-merge is off), maintainer_merges (always true), gate_suite_ran (claims only the gate suite, never a branch-protection rule).

variants.text: the readiness report's hand-off stands, so a maintainer may merge it
the next board-loop run re-evaluates it from a fresh snapshot
the board loop merges this PR itself on a later run once its own merge conditions hold
the board loop's auto-merge is off, so this PR waits for a maintainer to merge it
the board loop is stopped by the kill switch, so nothing merges this PR until the switch is cleared; a maintainer may merge it
